newsitem.title: USA: American BioMed, Diagnostic Ultra in pact.
newsitem.headline: American BioMed, Diagnostic Ultra in pact.

text.p: American BioMed Inc said Tuesday that it signed a letter of intent with Diagnostic Ultrasound Corp for a multi-year business development agreement/strategic alliance worth $2.5 to $5.0 million a year to American BioMed.
The alliance has three project phases, project development, prototype and commercial production (OEM manufacturing) to develop and produce an antimicrobial Foley balloon catheter.
The company said that estimated OEM annual revenues to American BioMed Inc under the agreement are $2.5 to $5.0 million.
